text: Low: with AGENTTALKS_BASE_URL unset, {{BASE_URL}} in /install and /skill.md comes from Host or X-Forwarded-Host and is substituted unescaped into HTML and into the skill an agent saves (ui.ts:153,161); a poisoned shared cache would point agents at an attacker's enroll URL. Compose defaults the variable to empty. Require baseUrl off loopback and escape.
